a: Vilnius Old Town, off Cathedral Square
w: Lithuanian monarchs were once crowned here with Gediminas' Cap, and the tradition never quite died: the cathedral still hosts a mass for every newly elected president, timed to their inauguration and oath to the Nation at the Seimas Palace next door.
s: Where monarchs were crowned, presidents still get their mass
_facts: Full name: Cathedral Basilica of St Stanislaus and St Ladislaus of Vilnius; the main Catholic cathedral in Lithuania
Situated in Vilnius Old Town, just off Cathedral Square
Previously used for inauguration ceremonies of Lithuanian monarchs with Gediminas' Cap
In modern times, a venue for masses dedicated to elected Presidents after their inauguration and oath to the Nation at the Seimas Palace
